// diagnostic

E0222

A part of `{name}` cannot be moved independently

What

A part of `{name}` cannot be moved independently

Why

Persistent and static storage must stay complete, and a value with its own Close implementation needs all its fields when it closes.

Fix

Move the complete owner, copy a copyable field, call a method the owner's type provides, or update persistent state atomically.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0222: tests/ui/E0222_close_nested.stderr.

Error [E0222]: A part of `held.value.first` cannot be moved independently
  --> tests/ui/E0222_close_nested.jet:8:26
    |
  8 |     taken :: ^held.value.first
    |                          ^^^^^
 Why: `ClosePair` has its own Close implementation, which needs the complete owner; this move would leave it with an empty field
 Fix: Move the Close owner as a whole, copy the field if its type supports copying, or call a method `ClosePair` provides
